answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Sparrowhawk keeper gyrfalcon mark flown at the hawking ground is that proof: each gyrfalcon is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. Ask the panel what it trusts: the vault it can verify, the lotus it can count, the zephyr it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 20 per proof, 12340 for 617, owed every epoch with no exception. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm.
